$comment: p15-oracle-097: e2e scripts 56-66 of MQ-e2e (`ls scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.py scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.sh`, sorted), each converted to a case of this suite or excluded with a reason (p15-oracle.md section 5, item 4). The scripts stay; each case's first step names its script. `fix` is the commit that made the behavior the case checks, `parent` that commit's parent: the case's acceptance is a Failure on `parent`. `catches` names the step (before the colon) that should show the bug there. `excluded` names a script no case can convert yet, with the reason, and its `gap` the follow-up and its owner task; such a script is not counted as converted. `gap` on a converted script names what its case leaves out. One file per batch, as _scripts-093.json and _scripts-094.json, so the batches (092-097) never edit the same file; oracle.py skips `_` files.
red_on_parent: not run: each parent predates the debug.oracle.* methods (they came with e0c736692e5, 2026-10-26), so driver_app refuses the launch (no-oracle-methods) before the first step. The fleet runs each case on its parent with oracle.py diff --overlay once p15-oracle-202 lands; until then `catches` is the expected failing step, not an observed one.

scripts/cmux-next/split-no-flicker-e2e.p.excluded: the bug (cx-ry0y, #19027; fix 79824b8b98858c71d6e32ab8e86733208f15123f, parent 6c003f305248f5c0b5baeb218d7f08f4bc777672) is a one-frame flash between turns: the provisional pane is undone when the daemon's reply lands and the daemon's pane shows a turn later (pane counts 1, 2, 1, 2). Cmd-D's turn checkpoint and the settled snapshot both show 2 panes on the parent too; the turn recorder records input turns only, and the script reads the shown pane-count history from debug.layout_counters, whose reply also holds counters that differ every run, so a cli step's expect, which compares the whole reply, cannot check it
scripts/cmux-next/split-no-flicker-e2e.p.gap: a shown pane-count history per workspace view in the layout facet (the counts each apply showed since the last snapshot) converts this script; owner p15-oracle-035 (Facet: layout)

scripts/cmux-next/split-typeahead-input-.excluded: its subject is real key-down events that CuaDriver posts to the app's process in the background (`--needs input`), which the window server delivers: case-v1 key steps go through debug.key, the app's own router, which is scripts/cmux-next/typeahead-compare.py's path, so a case would test the other script. Its check is also a count: the marker `tk<N>` appears exactly once in the new terminal and in no other one, and the terminals facet gives each screen as a hash of its last 24 rows, which cannot count a line
scripts/cmux-next/split-typeahead-input-.gap: an input step that posts window-server events (the GUI lane's CuaDriver) is the app driver's (p15-oracle-047 follow-up); the exactly-once check needs a per-terminal marker count in the terminals facet (p15-oracle-044)

scripts/cmux-next/strip-drop-e2e.py.excluded: drags a tab with debug.mouse at hand pace (one move per display frame for 0.7 s) to 85% and 15% of the other pane's tab frame, read from debug.tab_drag (cx-6ggef, #21626, fix da93c049e23): case-v1 has no pointer step, and the drop point is arithmetic on a frame read at run time, which a $step: reference cannot compute; a single debug.mouse drag through a cli step sends the moves in one burst, which the script says reaches the drop differently from a hand
scripts/cmux-next/strip-drop-e2e.py.gap: a pointer step (press, paced moves, release at a fraction of a facet frame) in case-v1 and driver_app converts this script and drop-ring-e2e.py; owner p15-oracle-047 follow-up

scripts/cmux-next/terminal-cmd-click-e2e.excluded: the bug (cx-7xss, #18917, fix 6f34520169e) is a main-thread stall: opening a Cmd-clicked link from inside Ghostty's mouse-release handler froze the app, and the script reads the watchdog (debug.hangs, no stall over 50 ms). On the parent the link still opens, so every state checkpoint matches; the stall is the perf lab's measure, not an oracle value. Its file case launches TextEdit (outside the app) and its captured-link case needs a Markdown file under a scratch folder, which driver_app does not build (no file fixture, no $CASE_ROOT paths)
scripts/cmux-next/terminal-cmd-click-e2e.gap: the stall belongs to the perf lab (perf-lead benches); the captured-link phase (u11857) converts when driver_app builds file fixtures (p15-oracle-200 hermetic per-case env)
